articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Plantation - Positive Catalysts Largely Priced In; Neutral View
articles.claim_summary: NEUTRAL stance on the Malaysian plantation sector: the 2026 CPO price rally (driven by elevated crude oil amid the US-Iran conflict and Indonesia's B50 biodiesel mandate) is seen as largely priced in already. CPO is expected to stay range-bound in 2026, with a floor near RM4,000/tonne from Indonesia's B50 diverting 3-4 million tonnes of palm oil from exports, but capped upside from record Brazilian soybean production compressing the palm-soy spread. Structural constraints include 32% of Malaysian palm trees aged above 19 years and low replanting rates limiting production growth.

findings.title: Palm oil futures hit RM4,927 as biofuels, El Niño cut supply - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The article supports key drivers mentioned in the claim, noting that Indonesia's B50 biodiesel mandate is poised to funnel more palm oil into fuel and curb exports, while futures hit RM4,977 a tonne amid tight supply.

findings.title: BMI raises 2026 average CPO price forecast to RM4,453 on tight supply - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The report supports the claim by projecting 2026 CPO prices at an average of RM4,453 per tonne (above RM4,000) and noting that Indonesia's biodiesel program will divert additional palm oil from the export market into domestic fuel, while Malaysian production eases 3.5%.

findings.title: Bessent's efforts in the Treasury market so far haven't worked. Here's what else he can try - CNBC

findings.title: Treasury yields rebound, wiping out the decline following Bessent's intervention - CNBC
